title: Multi-strategy intervention for promoting bicycle mobility, health, and sustainability in the context of existing city development in Duesseldorf
summary: Over the next three years, Düsseldorf will introduce several changes to make the city more bicycle-friendly. This includes building new bicycle lanes and adding improvements like more rental bicycles and bicycle-sharing stations. The UNITY project is exploring how these changes influence whether and how people choose to cycle. A new bicycle route in two neighborhoods with different living conditions will be observed. Researchers will count how many people use the route at the beginning of the study, after one year, and after two years. In addition, randomly selected people from both neighborhoods will take part in an online survey and group interviews to better understand why people choose to cycle – or why they do not cycle.

interventions.name: Evaluation of the impact of a multi-strategy intervention on bicycle use: Comparison of cyclist counts along a route that underwent infrastructural modifications (intervention site).
vs. cyclist counts along comparable, unchanged routes (control sites).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
No physical impairments that prevent cycling.
Exclusion criteria:
Individuals under the age of 18 years or with physical impairments that prevent cycling.
